map.F 方差检验计算器 使用指南: F variance test calculator - user guide
map.F 方差检验计算器：输入两组样本方差与自由度，计算 F 统计量与临界值，检验两总: F variance test calculator: enter two groups' sample variances and degrees of freedom, compute the F statistic and critical value, test whether two population variances are equal, for homogeneity-of-variance judgment.
map.两样本方差齐性：F=s1²/s2²。: Two-sample variance homogeneity: F = s1^2 / s2^2.
map.ANOVA 中组间/组内均方比。: Ratio of between-group to within-group mean squares in ANOVA.
map.：s1=12、s2=10：F=144/100=1.44，df=(n1−1,n2−: : s1=12, s2=10: F=144/100=1.44, df=(n1-1,n2-1). Close to 1 means variances are equal.
map.：组间 MSB=30、组内 MSW=15：F=2.0，df=(2,27)，查表临: : between-group MSB=30, within-group MSW=15: F=2.0, df=(2,27), table critical about 3.35, not significant.
map.通常把大方差放分子使 F≥1，与单尾临界比较；方差齐性检验看双尾。: Usually put the larger variance in the numerator so F >= 1, compare with the one-tailed critical; the homogeneity test uses two tails.
map.F 检验对正态敏感？: Is the F test sensitive to normality?
map.是，方差齐性检验对非正态较敏感，可考虑 Levene 检验更稳健。: Yes, the variance-homogeneity test is sensitive to non-normality; consider the more robust Levene test.
